integrity: All-order proof includes polar duality, TU-integrality, diameter-two level restriction and exact extremal classification; verifier is standalone and does not substitute for proof; general graph-spread and polar identities acknowledged as previously known.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for n>=5, simple deleted graph of maximum degree exactly two, canonical root-coordinate polytope and intrinsic Euclidean norm; number of tangent facets belongs to the origin-centered maximal inball; no full incenter-locus classification; finite verification to n=11 is not the infinite proof.
title: Complete inball contact spectrum of dense symmetric edge polytopes under degree-two deletions
